name: Sigakhwa Bookmarks & TOC
description: Name and bookmark any message, jump back to it later (across conversations), and browse a table of contents of the current conversation built from headings, tables and Mermaid diagrams. Stored in the browser by default; an optional token-protected loopback sidecar shares bookmarks between devices (PC and phone).
author: johnDEFI

post_install.summary: Works immediately with browser-local storage. For PC/phone sync, start the bundled sidecar (see README), make sure WebUI password auth is on, then press Approve proxy consent in Settings -> Extensions -> Diagnostics -> Sidecars and reload.
